effectSummary: Choose the bones or corpse of a Small or Medium humanoid in range. Bones rise as a skeleton and a corpse as a zombie. Recasting on controlled creatures before that period ends renews control for another 24 hours over up to four of your animated undead instead of creating a new one. An attack is one melee slam against a target within 5 feet using the size-based bonus and bludgeoning damage, though the DM can make it slashing or piercing when appropriate. effectSummary: A 10-foot-radius barrier stays centered on and moves with you. name: Antimagic Field
components: M (a pinch of powdered iron or iron filings)
effectSummary: A 10-foot-radius antimagic sphere moves with you. Except for magic created by artifacts or deities, spells and magical effects are suppressed inside it and cannot extend into it; a spell slot spent on a suppressed casting is still consumed, and suppression time still counts against an effect's duration. A spell or magical effect targeting a creature or object in the sphere has no effect on that target, and overlapping magical areas are suppressed only where they overlap the sphere. Existing magic on creatures or objects is suppressed while inside. Magic-item properties and powers are suppressed; a magic weapon or ammunition used from or against the sphere is nonmagical while subject to it, but regains its magic once fully outside. Teleportation and planar travel cannot start or end there, and portals or extradimensional openings temporarily close while inside. Creatures or objects summoned or created by magic temporarily vanish in the sphere and reappear when their occupied space is no longer within it. Dispel magic and similar effects do not affect the sphere, and overlapping antimagic fields do not cancel one another.
generatedDescription: Antimagic Field is a D&D 5e level 8 spell in abjuration. Source: Player's Handbook.

name: Antipathy/Sympathy
components: M (either a lump of alum soaked in vinegar for the antipathy effect or a drop of honey for the sympathy effect)
effectSummary: Target a Huge or smaller creature or object, or an area no larger than a 200-foot cube, then designate a kind of intelligent creature and choose antipathy or sympathy for 10 days. Sympathy: a designated creature that sees the target or comes within 60 feet makes a Wisdom save or must spend movement each turn entering the area or moving within reach, after which it cannot willingly move away; if the target harms it, it can make a Wisdom save to end the effect. For either mode, an affected creature that ends its turn both unable to see the target and outside 60 feet makes a Wisdom save to end the effect, and it also gets another save every 24 hours. A creature that succeeds on a save against the effect is immune to it for 1 minute.
generatedDescription: Antipathy/Sympathy is a D&D 5e level 8 spell in enchantment. Source: Player's Handbook.

effectSummary: Create an invisible hovering magical eye within range and mentally receive its visual information. It has normal vision plus darkvision to 30 feet and can look in every direction. generatedDescription: Arcane Eye is a D&D 5e level 4 spell in divination. Source: Player's Handbook.

name: Arcane Gate

generatedDescription: Arcane Gate is a D&D 5e level 6 spell in conjuration. Source: Player's Handbook.

generatedDescription: Arcane Hacking (UA) is a D&D 5e level 2 spell in transmutation (technomagic). Source: Unearthed Arcana 7 - Modern Magic.

generatedDescription: Arcane Lock is a D&D 5e level 2 spell in abjuration. Source: Player's Handbook.

effectSummary: Choose one simple or martial weapon you are holding and one of acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, or thunder. generatedDescription: Arcane Weapon (UA) is a D&D 5e level 1 spell in transmutation. Source: Unearthed Arcana 60 - The Artificer Returns.

generatedDescription: Armor of Agathys is a D&D 5e level 1 spell in abjuration. Source: Player's Handbook.

generatedDescription: Arms of Hadar is a D&D 5e level 1 spell in conjuration. Source: Player's Handbook.

generatedDescription: Ashardalon's Stride is a D&D 5e level 3 spell in Transmutation. Source: Fizban's Treasury of Dragons.

name: Astral Projection
components: M (for each creature you affect with this spell, you must provide one jacinth worth at least 1,000 gp and one ornately carved bar of silver worth at least 100 gp, all of which the spell consumes)

You can dismiss the spell as an action for yourself and your companions, returning affected creatures to their bodies. For an individual creature, the spell also ends if dispel magic succeeds against either its astral or physical body or if either form reaches 0 HP; with an intact cord, its astral form is pulled back and suspended animation ends. generatedDescription: Blindness/Deafness is a D&D 5e level 2 spell in necromancy. Source: Player's Handbook.
